t_advice_summary_textbox.text: If its x1 select the left side 's' and if its x5 select the right side 'k'. If its a small gnome it will get more points either side

vb_textbox.text: If the mulitpiler at the start is x1, you are better off selecting the gnome on the left 'S' and if its x5 the gnome on the right 'K'. However, if the two gnomes are different sizes you are better off picking the smaller one.
